thread:
Alex: Quick check — wrapping up INC-912 postmortem. I put together a short owner/due list. Please reply with a one-word ack (or "hold" if you need more time) and new due if you change it. Need clear owners to close the action tracker.

OpsBot: Incident: INC-912 (primary DB failover). Runbook: <https://redwood.ai/incidents/INC-912|INC-912 runbook> · Postmortem draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/INC-912

Alex: Current action items (compact):
```
A) add safe-rollback procedure to runbook -> owner: Cheng -> due: 2024-03-01
B) tuning for failover alert thresholds -> owner: Tara -> due: 2024-03-03
C) ingest-side throttling guard -> owner: Jon -> due: 2024-03-04
D) runbook smoke check script -> owner: Alex -> due: 2024-02-29
E) cross-team review of migration test plan -> owner: Maya -> due: 2024-03-02
```

Maya: ack — Ill coordinate the cross-team reviewers (infra-apps, analytics). Will post a short agenda.

Cheng: ack. Started a dry-run for the rollback steps; hit a nullable-index edge case. New ETA 2024-03-02 if I need the extra fix. Will attach test logs.

Tara: hold — need SRE-observability to confirm thresholds and likely alert noise. @Priya can you advise on 95p/99p windows? I won't open the PR until thresholds are aligned.

Priya: ack — I can look today. For DB failover alerts we usually set 99p latency + error-rate spike as primary. I'll add notes and propose numbers by COB.

Jon: ack. I have a throttling PoC but blocked on a tiny ingest API change (PR 501). If API lands earlier I can finish the guard. Otherwise I'll gate behind a feature flag. @Alex any release window guidance?

Alex: Release window for infra patches is Mar 2-4. Feature-flag approach is fine to land earlier if needed.

Cheng: posting a snippet from my dry-run failure:
```
ERROR: migration staging failed at row 9876 - violates not-null constraint
context: migration_v2 -> step 3
```
I'll open a reproducible issue with steps and a small patch suggestion.

Maya: I'll invite product analytics and infra-apps to an async review thread. Plan: reviewers ack + comments inside two business days.

Tara: created a draft PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/alerts/215 — adding Priya and Alex as reviewers.

Jon: PR 501 assigned back to Alex for API contract confirmation. If Alex is blocked, Maya can broker.

Alex: I'll verify the API contract this afternoon. If I'm delayed, Maya please step in. Also we need a designated verifier for runbook smoke check post-change.

Maya: I can validate public-runbook steps. Cheng, can you sanity-check the DB-specific commands for safety?

Cheng: confirmed — adding a short note for the probe and an example command to include in the runbook:
```
kubectl exec -c postgres -it pod/postgres-0 -- psql -c "select count(*) from replication_lag where lag_seconds < 10;"
```

Alex: Nice. Ops ask: keep a single-line ack per person (and updated due if changed) so I can mark the tracker closed.

Cheng: ack -> 2024-03-02
Tara: ack -> 2024-03-03 (pending Priya numbers)
Jon: ack -> 2024-03-04 (may be earlier with feature-flag)
Maya: ack -> coordinating reviews
Alex: ack -> will add smoke-check script by 2024-02-29
Priya: ack -> will post threshold recommendations by EOD today

OpsBot: INC-912 tracker updated by Alex. Reminder: auto-close when all acks received and linked PRs merged. :robot_face:

Jon: I'll post a status update in this thread once PRs are green.

Alex: Thanks team. If anything blocks the reviewers or PRs, call it out here and we'll escalate to oncall.
